title: Lior and the Salt
author: Wren Okafor
blurb: Gideon Joubert, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
